label_loader_contract.split_source: for each outer o, H_o is the exact Stage-1a manifest-pinned held order and T_o is its ordered 1,600-session complement; no archive member defines or changes the split
label_loader_contract.materialization: process one outer fold at a time; decompress exactly one allowed member, copy only that outer fold's ordered T_o rows, release the complete decompressed member, run first and repeat independently, then release the complete T_o bundle before the next outer fold
label_loader_contract.compressed_member_disclosure: physical decompression may transiently expose complete-member bytes including the current H_o rows, but H_o rows are never copied from the decompressed member or retained in the current outer-fold bundle
label_loader_contract.shared_between_passes: the current outer fold's immutable T_o-only input bundle may be reused by first and repeat; all derived labels, weights, fits, probabilities, utilities, thresholds, and policies must be recomputed independently

frozen_surface_contract.worker_order: outer_0 first then repeat through outer_4 first then repeat, releasing each T_o-only bundle before opening the archive for the next outer
frozen_surface_contract.surface_array_shape_and_hash_source: the Stage-1a result records bound above

selector_shape_amendment.reason: the frozen v2.7 Python-3.9 subset hard-codes MAX_ACTIONS=3 while the single preregistered top-5 depth change produces a padded action axis of 15
selector_shape_amendment.implementation: derive the slot width from each validated surface, require it to equal 15, and use that width for isolated-label loops, flattening, session and family repetition, probability allocation, and coverage
selector_shape_amendment.required_compatibility: on valid width-3 synthetic inputs, the adapted helpers must reproduce the hash-pinned v2.7 Python-3.9 helper bit-for-bit for labels, weights, probabilities, quantile, threshold, supplement, and final policy
unchanged_fields: the frozen 19 feature names, order, and values
model type, parameters, seed, and preprocessing

heads: isolated composite reciprocal-rank and MTTC regret
unchanged_selector_contract.isolated_labels: attach labels to every target-blind available oof_T action by replacing that action alone over the complete domain-local current policy
unchanged_selector_contract.weight_normalization: normalize each head's available action weights to sum to one within each session
unchanged_selector_contract.model: two C=0.2 liblinear L2 logistic heads, fit_intercept=true, max_iter=300, random_state=20260830
unchanged_selector_contract.preprocessing: weighted mean and scale fitted only on the actual training rows; scales below 1e-8 become one
unchanged_selector_contract.readiness: available rows are nonempty and rescue and regret each have two classes in addition to both distinct-rescue minima
unchanged_selector_contract.within_turn_tie_break: higher utility, then greater three-family support-bit count, then lower candidate ordinal
unchanged_selector_contract.session_policy: turns in ascending order; take the first winner meeting the mapped threshold and latch the session after at most one supplement

nested_workflow.inner_training: for inner j, fit both heads only on available oof_T action rows whose T_o session has inner_fold != j and score only inner_fold == j rows
nested_workflow.inner_coverage: when all five fits are ready, every available oof_T action row is scored exactly once and no unavailable row is scored
nested_workflow.readiness_failure: if any inner fit is not ready or has no validation action, select KEEP for the complete outer fold
nested_workflow.inner_selection: simulate the exact causal policy for every fixed quantile using T_o labels only
nested_workflow.inner_safety: aggregate and every inner fold require hit-to-miss=0, net hits>=0, rounded and unrounded MRR delta>=0, and rounded and unrounded MTTC delta<=0
nested_workflow.inner_evidence: aggregate miss-to-hit>=1 and at least two inner folds have miss-to-hit>0
nested_workflow.selection_key: higher TechnicalScore delta, higher net rescue, more positive inner folds, fewer supplement turns, then higher quantile
nested_workflow.outer_fit: for a finite selected quantile, refit both heads on all available T_o oof_T action rows; an unready outer fit fails closed to KEEP
nested_workflow.reference_mapping: score target-free T_o reference_T actions and map the selected quantile over per-turn winner utilities using the frozen higher method
nested_workflow.held_application: score target-free H_o held_H actions and apply the one mapped reference threshold once with the unchanged causal latch
nested_workflow.keep: write the fixed output schema with zero selector surfaces and preserve domain-local current bit-for-bit
